description: Suggest a change to the database: add a brand (add_brand), correct a listing (correct_listing), report that an agent was stopped on a site (report_block), or report that a task now works (report_works). Every submission goes to a human review queue; nothing is published automatically, and a listing only changes once it is verified from a brand statement or official docs, reputable reporting, or our own documented test. Do not include personal data about the user.

agent.description: Agent product, e.g. Meta Muse, ChatGPT agent, Claude, Grok.

domain.description: Domain or URL the update is about.

evidence_url.description: https link to a screenshot or log of what happened.

source_url.description: https link to a brand statement, official doc or article.

name: submit_update
title: Submit an update for human review
